name: Estrild Marsh
memories: I danced with Gilbert Thornvale of House Thornvale. I think of nothing else.
The Forbidden Match of Marsh and Thornvale: Letters pass between Estrild Marsh and Gilbert Thornvale, hidden in loaves and saddlebags. A maid of House Highfell reads one, and tells.

The Forbidden Match of Marsh and Thornvale: Estrild Marsh kneels before Godric Marsh and asks to marry Gilbert Thornvale of House Thornvale. Godric Marsh says he will think about it, and sends a rider to Guthrum Thornvale.

The Forbidden Match of Marsh and Thornvale: Bells ring in Rosegarden: Estrild Marsh marries Gilbert Thornvale, and House Highfell and House Thornvale drink from one cup. The old grudges are buried, for now.
